hammer.notes: Double-faced head: striking_face_center = left face (image -x), striking_face_center_alt = right face. handle_pivot_grip_end = bottom end of the pommel on the handle axis; grip_center = middle of the leather grip.

chisel.notes: blade edge is seen end-on (wedge taper in profile); blade_tip = cutting edge centre, striking_top_center = centre of the butt top.

strike_pose_example.description: as in profiles_preview.jpg: scale chisel by hammer.px_per_m/chisel.px_per_m (true relative size), rotate the hammer 90deg counter-clockwise (screen) so its left face points down, put hammer striking_face_center on chisel striking_top_center

coordinates: pixels in each PNG, origin top-left, x right, y down; glow PNGs share the canvas of their beauty PNG
